shapeSummary: Flat aluminum stadium-shaped (round-end) plate, 56 x 32 mm and 2.5 mm thick. The plate lies in the XZ plane with its bottom at Y=0 and its thickness along +Y. Two 14 mm through holes sit at X=±12 mm, concentric with the 16 mm end radii.
warnings: The roughly 14 smaller holes and slotted holes in the 16mm goBILDA pattern are visible in the image. Their diameters and exact positions are not stated, so they are omitted rather than guessed.
The dimensions are marked unverified in the source data.
The 14 mm hole positions at X=±12 mm are inferred from the 24 mm center spacing and the 16 mm end radius.
cadquery:
plate = cq.Workplane('XZ').slot2D(56, 32).extrude(-2.5)
bores = cq.Workplane('XZ').pushPoints([(-12, 0), (12, 0)]).circle(7).extrude(-2.5)
part = plate.cut(bores)
